Data & methodology

Primary sourceDepartment of Customs, Government of Nepal
Current release—
Release typeCumulative fiscal-year workbook
Presentation unitRs billion

How monthly movement is calculated

Department of Customs releases are cumulative within the fiscal year. TradePulse preserves the official cumulative values and derives a single month by subtracting the previous cumulative release from the latest one.

What TradePulse changes

TradePulse restructures official tables for analysis, adds unit conversions, ranks products and partners, and computes transparent descriptive signals. It does not replace the source workbook.

For formal or legal use, verify figures against the original Department of Customs release.
